$comment: Generated by tools/gen_params.py from the firmware sources. Do not edit by hand.

scopes.sound: 0..246: kit (edit buffer) parameters, stored in .snd files and kit SysEx dumps
scopes.pattern: 247..271: sequencer/step/performance UI parameters; not stored in .snd

midi_rules.cc: Sound params 0..126 map to CC (id+1) on the voice's channel or the global channel. CC0 is bank select (kit load), so param 127 is not reachable via CC.
midi_rules.nrpn: Sound params 128..246 map to NRPN (id-128): CC99=msb, CC98=lsb, CC6=value (7-bit).
midi_rules.panel_edits: Stock firmware does not transmit CC/NRPN for panel edits. Use SysEx parameter echo (docs/sysex.md) on firmware that supports it.
midi_rules.mod_target_values: VEL_DEST_x / TARGET_LFOx / P1_DEST / P2_DEST hold a modTargets index in memory, .snd files and SysEx; over NRPN the value is the target parameter number.
